agreed.medi_said: آآآ على عشرة.
agreed.why: Clock time takes el-; her whole reply was الـ and he fixed it to على العشرة (GR-25: one A1 el- prompt).

agreed.why: kaan must carry the I-ending with أنا (kunt); she said أنا كنت and he repeated أنا كنت شوي.

agreed.amal_said: We never say هذا الصبح just say الصبح or بالصباح.

agreed.medi_said: راح أروح على and عموي.

agreed.medi_said: So الساعة el awal
agreed.amal_said: Yes. بس we learned how to say الأول for a feminine. What is it? Do you remember?
agreed.why: ساعة is feminine so the adjective is الأولى; she prompted and he said الساعة الأولى.

agreed.medi_said: المصاري راح يجي، uh, في... في تاني يوم.
agreed.amal_said: No, that's not two days. Second week.

agreed.why: She had just told him مصاري is plural, so the verb is يجو (her chat yiju); she voiced nothing on the verb.

agreed.medi_said: هذي اليوم التانية.
agreed.amal_said: مم، مم، هذي اليوم. ... مرة، هذي المرة.

agreed.why: He put اليوم (day) where المرة (time) was meant; she echoed هذي اليوم then said مرة، هذي المرة and he redid it.

agreed.medi_said: So ساعة الأول-- It should be ساعة الأول. ساعة، ساعة أـ...
agreed.why: Feminine ساعة needs الأولى and the noun needs el- too; she recast الساعة الأولى.

agreed.medi_said: الأول اليوم. No, that's the-- Isn't that the first day?
agreed.why: Adjective must follow the noun; she said his الأول اليوم means nothing and gave اليوم الأول.
agreed.proposed_rule: Tool words awal / aa5er / taani / 8eir go BEFORE a bare noun with no el- (awal saa3a, taani youm, 7ada taani = someone else); AFTER the noun they act as adjectives, take el- with the noun and agree (el-saa3a el-oola); aa5er + el-noun = the end of (aa5er el-ijtimaa3)

agreed.medi_said: And then مرة, uh, مرة الأخر.

agreed.medi_said: مرة الأخيرة.

agreed.medi_said: هي ال، الختيارة ال أول. Is it awwal?
